item.title: Low-pressure operation of all-solid-state batteries enabled by an organic electrode
item.description:
این مقاله نشان می‌دهد استفاده از یک الکترود آلی، امکان کارکرد باتری تمام‌جامد را در فشار پایین و بدون نیاز به فشار انباشت بالا فراهم می‌کند.
Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in using low-modulus, low-hardness, creep-compliant organic electrodes (TAQ) that deform adaptively, eliminating the high stack pressures (tens of MPa) usually needed for solid-state batteries. Significance: stable cycling at 1 MPa (80.3% retention after 100 cycles) and structural integrity down to 0.2 MPa, establishing mechanically adaptive materials design for practical low-pressure solid-state batteries.

item.title: Electron Bridge Effect Enhanced Tandem Catalysis for Efficient Nitrate Reduction to Ammonia
item.description:
کاتالیزور MoCoB با اثر پل الکترونی و کاتالیز پشتسرهم، بازده تولید NH3 از NO3- را با FE بالا افزایش داده و در باتری هیبریدی Zn-نیترات عملکرد پایداری نشان میدهد.
Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a molten-salt-etched ternary boride MoCoB with a boron electronic bridge enabling tandem catalysis: Mo activates nitrate, Co supplies active hydrogen, and B accelerates electron/proton transfer. This synergy yields high ammonia production (61.89 mg h⁻¹ mgcat⁻¹, 98.73% FE) and enables a durable Zn-nitrate/ethanol hybrid battery producing ammonium acetate, offering a design strategy for efficient nitrate reduction and reversible Zn-based energy systems.
🏷 nitrate reduction · ammonia synthesis · MoCoB electrocatalyst · electron bridge · Zn-based battery

item.title: SEI Evolution on Siloxene Anodes in Solid and Liquid Electrolytes via an Ion‐Sieving/Electron‐Conducting Interfacial Layer
item.description:
لایه واسط رسانای الکترون و غربالگر یون بر پایه siloxene، تکامل SEI را در الکترولیت مایع و جامد مقایسه کرده و پوشش LiF غنی و نازکتری در هر دو سیستم ایجاد میکند.
Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a siloxene-based LP@SONS architecture combining electron-conducting polypyrrole with a Li⁺-selective ion-sieving layer, enabling direct comparison of SEI evolution in liquid versus solid electrolytes. It reveals that electrolyte contact geometry governs SEI dimensionality (3D bulk-permeated vs. 2D planar-confined), yielding thinner, LiF-rich interphases and stable cycling with only ~5% thickness expansion—offering a general interfacial engineering strategy for high-capacity anodes.
🏷 siloxene anode · solid electrolyte interphase · solid-state battery · ion-sieving layer · LiF-rich interphase

item.title: Novel Fluorinated Amino‐Ester Electrolyte With Host–Guest Solvation Enables High‐Voltage and Thermally Safe Lithium–Metal Batteries
item.description:
این مقاله با الکترولیت آمینو-استر فلوئوردار و ساختار حل‌پوشی میزبان-میهمان، باتری لیتیوم-فلز با ولتاژ بالا، ایمنی حرارتی و چگالی انرژی 550 Wh/kg را ممکن می‌سازد.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a host–guest solvation design using fluorinated amino-ester solvents (TFE/HFS) with polarity contrast, enabling LiF/Li₂O-rich interphases. Significance: this electrolyte delivers 550 Wh kg⁻¹ in a 22.4 Ah pouch cell, 260-cycle stability with 95.2% retention at 4.5 V, and improved nail-penetration/thermal safety—advancing practical high-energy, safe lithium-metal batteries.
🏷 lithium-metal battery · fluorinated electrolyte · host-guest solvation · high-voltage · thermal safety
